text:
maria-support: customer says tool call fails with "invalid_json" when args include Windows path and $ENV. Repro attached.

maria-support: ```json
{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\Jane\\Documents\\report.pdf","metadata":"owner:$JANE_HOME","options":{"ocr":true,},}
```

maria-support: curl they used:

maria-support: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/call -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tool":"pdf_extract","args": "{\"file_path\":\"C:\\\\Users\\\\Jane\\\\Documents\\\\report.pdf\",\"metadata\":\"owner:$JANE_HOME\",\"options\":{\"ocr\":true,},}"}'
```

ingrid-eng: looks like two problems: unescaped backslashes and trailing commas. The client is sending args as a string containing JSON; our tool schema expects args as an object. That double-encoding plus bad commas breaks parser.

sri-oncall: can we reproduce locally? give me exact client lib + OS.

maria-support: client is node 18, windows 10, using fetch polyfill (node-fetch 2.6). They copy-pasted from Windows explorer which added backslashes and also used environment var $JANE_HOME. They say it worked with a different tool call earlier.

ingrid-eng: repro steps (short):
1) create payload with raw string containing backslashes and $var
2) send via fetch body as JSON.stringify({tool:'pdf_extract', args: rawString})

ingrid-eng: quick fix: ensure args is an object and JSON-encode properly. e.g. args: {"file_path":"C:\\Users\\Jane\\Documents\\report.pdf","metadata":{"owner":"${JANE_HOME}"},"options":{"ocr":true}}

maria-support: asked customer to try. They responded: still 400 but different: "tool_args_schema_mismatch: expected object, got string" :thumbsup:

ci-bot: triggered test-run on branch issue/escape-toolargs — logs: "parser: strict-json parse error on line 1: trailing comma".

sri-oncall: propose server-side error message improvement: if args is string try to parse and validate and return friendly hint: 'args appears to be a JSON string — send as object, remove trailing commas, escape backslashes' + link to docs.

ingrid-eng: +1. Also add client-side SDK helper that validates & auto-normalizes common Windows path escapes and warns about shell $VAR in json.

maria-support: customer OK with workaround for now. leaving as P2. will escalate if they can't patch.

sri-oncall: assigning eva-eng to follow up on SDK patch. :eyes:

maria-support: thanks all. closing loop with customer now.
